blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two bus terminals in Manila will be summoned by the Department of Transportation (DOTr) to fix their facilities and improve the passenger experience, new Transport chief Vince Dizon said on Wednesday. Dizon inspected Ohayami Trans, Florida Bus Terminal, and Victory Liner in Sampaloc, Manila ahead of the expected influx of passengers for commemoration of this year’s Undas. Dizon flagged Ohayami Trans for having a cramped waiting area and lack of toilet bowls in the men’s restroom. He also pointed out the low water pressure and faulty flush toilets in the Victory Liner, as well as its waiting area. […]...
